mod.apocalypse_firstlight.name: Apocalypse: First Light
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.simple_hea: Temporary earmuffs made of simple materials can significantly relieve tinnitus and reduce external sounds.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.road_curve: Curve to the left, advisory 30 MPH
Curve to the right, advisory 30 MPH
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.br51_exten: A 35-round extended magazine designed for the BR-51, significantly increasing sustained fire capability.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.br51_drum_: A 50-round twin-drum magazine designed for the BR-51, greatly extending sustained fire at the cost of a slower empty reload.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.rifle_red_: A universal rifle red dot sight that provides a clear aiming point for faster target acquisition.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.rifle_supp: A quick-detach 7.62×51mm rifle suppressor that mounts over a compatible flash hider, greatly reducing gunshot noise propagation and muzzle flash.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.heavy_supp: A large quick-detach 12.7×55mm suppressor that mounts over a compatible muzzle brake and sleeves back over the barrel, greatly reducing gunshot noise propagation and muzzle flash.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.p9_01_exte: A 28-round extended magazine built for the P9-01: a lengthened steel magazine with a grip-extension sleeve and a reinforced floorplate, greatly improving sustained fire.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.pistol_sup: A 9mm pistol muzzle device that greatly reduces gunshot noise propagation and muzzle flash.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.pistol_mic: A compact pistol sight that provides a clear aiming point for faster close-range target acquisition.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.pistol_red: A compact pistol optic with a lightly tinted lens.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.br51_01.de: A select-fire battle rifle chambered in 7.62×51mm, offering strong power and range at the cost of heavy recoil that is hard to control on full auto.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.hr55.descr: A heavy semi-automatic battle rifle chambered in 12.7×55mm, delivering formidable stopping power at close and medium range.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.silverwood: A modern over-under sporting shotgun with a two-chamber break action and 12 Gauge buckshot.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.blackridge: A heavy semi-automatic pistol chambered in .50 AE.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.p9_01.desc: A compact and reliable 9mm service pistol, easy to handle and well suited for close-range combat.
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.cat.descri: Please do not ask how it works....

tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.clinical_t: Hold right-click for about 3 s to take your body temperature; the reading shows in the temperature dial for 10 s
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.wrist_ther: Worn on the wrist; shows the air temperature
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.creative_f: Creative only. Use on a tank, an open fill cover or filler: pours as much as fits at once; it cannot be filled
tooltip.apocalypse_firstlight.fuel_can.u: Use on an open fill cover or filler: crouch and pour, stopping when it is empty (use again to stop); sneak + use to set it down
